item.title: mgk & Wiz Khalifa Head Back to 2010 for Nostalgic ‘Blog Era Boyz’ Mixtape: Stream It Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We've got some exciting news for fans of MGK and Wiz Khalifa. The two rappers have just dropped a joint mixtape called "Blog Era Boyz".
[Short music clip plays]
Host: This collaboration is a nod to their breakthrough era in the early 2010s. The duo first teamed up back in 2013 for the track "Mind of a Stoner" and have rekindled their working relationship in 2026 with singles "Girl Next Door" and "Everything Tatted".
[Short music clip plays]
Host: The mixtape boasts nine tracks, fueled by friendship and nostalgia. And if you're lucky, you can catch them performing live together on MGK's Lost Americana Tour, which is currently underway and will be visiting cities like Austin, Dallas, and Toronto.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: Both artists have been busy lately. MGK's 2025 album "Lost Americana" went to number one on the Top Rock & Alternative Albums chart, and he recently collaborated with Limp Bizkit's Fred Durst on the track "Fix Ur Face".
[Short music clip plays]
Host: Wiz Khalifa has also been keeping his fans fed with new music, releasing five projects so far this year, including the "Moses the Black" soundtrack and a joint album with Curren$y.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for now. You can stream the "Blog Era Boyz" mixtape now. Thanks for tuning in!
